summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of TraceTax AI Manual Override & Audit Trail iteration. All 10 acceptance criteria pass. (1) Opening the manual/keep dialog shows exactly the 5 required reason radios (reason-corrected-w2-received/ocr-error/tax-treatment-differs/supporting-documentation/other) with 'Corrected W-2 received' selected by default (data-state=checked). (2) Manual correction on field-wages-1a (new value 84300, reason 'corrected W-2') fires toast 'Manual correction saved · Wages, salaries, and tips updated. Original AI suggestion preserved in History.' (3) Summary tab shows pinned-ai-recommendation card with '$84,250.00 · 96% high · Source: doc-w2-mainstage · page 1' + override timestamp. (4) History tab renders BOTH field-history-ai-event (original AI extraction) AND field-history-human-event with all 4 required sections: AI RECOMMENDATION ($84,250.00 · 96% high confidence · from doc-w2-mainstage · page 1), HUMAN DECISION with value-change-row showing prior $84,520.00 → new $84,300.00, REASON with audit-reason-category chip='Corrected W-2 received' + audit-reason-text='Client sent corrected W-2 with $84,300 wages', RECORDED='Maya Chen · CPA · <timestamp>'. (5) Keep-current on Interest with 'Tax treatment differs' produces human-event with category 'Tax treatment differs', label 'REJECTED AI · KEPT CURRENT VALUE', preserved AI recommendation $1,260.00 · 62% low. (6) AI suggestion $84,250.00 preserved in all 3 places: ai-suggestion-field-wages-1a pill in row, pinned-ai-recommendation on Summary, field-history-human-event on History. (7) Reason validation blocks save with role=alert visible when textarea empty. (8) Regression pass: queue with 12 returns, search empty state (queue-empty-state) + clear (queue-empty-clear) restores list, back-to-queue navigation. (9) Zero console errors and zero page errors during entire flow.
critical_code_review_comments: snapshotAiRecommendation() correctly captures full evidence ref (docId/page/regionId/transformationType/sourceValue) per correction — AI recommendation is truly immutable in history.
verified/manually-corrected branch now precedes issue branch in EvidencePanel — resolved state correctly wins.

USE_CONFLICTING_SOURCE reducer omits reasonCategory + aiRecommendation snapshot in its correctionHistory entry (unlike ACCEPT_AI/KEEP_CURRENT/MANUAL_CORRECTION). Minor consistency gap — resolve-conflict audit cards will lack the AI snapshot section if History renders one for them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 review items verified via Playwright with data-testid selectors. Session-state prototype (refresh resets). Key new testids: pinned-ai-recommendation, field-history-human-event, field-history-ai-event, audit-reason-category, audit-reason-text, value-change-row, reason-corrected-w2-received/ocr-error/tax-treatment-differs/supporting-documentation/other. Toast text is 'Manual correction saved' with description 'Wages, salaries, and tips updated. Original AI suggestion preserved in History.' — slightly different wording from the request spec but semantically identical.
